title: Entralink buff catalogue
description: The buffs of the Entralink roguelike (docs/paperwhite2/design/entralink-buffs.md): three tiers of cards, the damage buckets they add to, the gold themes, the offers' settings and the balance meter's example. Each buff's effect is one of a fixed list of effect kinds (the effect_* definitions), so the game implements kinds, not entries. tools/paperwhite2/entralink_buffs.py checks it and writes the generated header.

offers.description: Cards offered after each battle, of which the player picks 1

tier_odds.description: Each card's tier odds by its source: after a battle (enemy, challenge, boss), a gift, a buff room, a shop

enemy.description: After an enemy or enemy-choice battle (and a rest room's bonus battle)

shop.description: A shop's buffs, the gold percent then times shop_gold_weight

boss_guaranteed_gold.description: A boss's offer has at least one gold card

shop_gold_weight.description: Golds' weight in shops: the shop row's gold percent times this, in percent

held_theme_weight.description: The weight of golds and related purples of a theme held, in percent

rank_up_weight.description: A held gold's weight while it can still rank up, in percent

gold_slots.description: Gold slots; with all full, a new gold replaces one

damage_cap.description: The final clamp on a hit's damage

boss_bar_hp.description: The most HP of one health bar (phase 5): a foe with more max HP shows ceil(max HP / this) bars of equal size, at most one more than bar_colors has, and damage over time on a foe is its fraction of one bar (of its max HP with a single bar)

bar_colors.description: The health bars' colours from bar 2 up (bar 1, the last to empty, is the vanilla bar: green, yellow, red), each to contrast with the one before; the bar's dark rows are its colour at 55%. Their count + 1 is the most bars a foe shows

boss_sleep_turns.description: The most turns a boss sleeps

boss_toxic_cap.description: Bad poison's ramp on a boss stops at this many sixteenths

boss_full_paralysis.description: A paralyzed boss's chance to be fully paralyzed, in percent of a foe's (vanilla 25%, Lockjaw's)

boss_fixed_damage.description: Fixed-damage moves on a boss (Super Fang, Endeavor) deal at most this percent of one bar; OHKO moves and Pain Split don't affect it

skip_dust.description: Dream Dust for skipping an offer

gift_buff_chance.description: Each gift card's chance to be a buff rather than an item, in percent

shop_buffs.description: Buffs each shop sells beside its items

type_card_team_weight.description: A type card's weight for the team's own types, in percent of the others'

damage_numbers.description: The damage numbers over a foe the team hits and a foe's HP on its gauge (phase 6); what is left out takes its default

battles.description: The battles that show them: none, the run's, or every battle but link battles

tiers.description: The colour tiers by the hit's damage, from 0 up: each swaps the digits' palette entries 14 (light) and 15 (dark) for its colours

from.description: The least damage of the tier

overlap.description: Pixels the digits overlap (each digit's cell has a blank column at each side)

group_space.description: Pixels between the thousands and the rest (12 345), instead of a comma

start_scale.description: The number's size as it appears, in percent of its normal size

start_alpha.description: Its opacity as it appears (31 opaque)

shrink_frames.description: Frames it takes to shrink to its normal size and opacity

hold_frames.description: Frames it holds at its normal size

fade_frames.description: Frames it fades out in, rising

rise.description: Pixels it rises while it fades

height.description: Pixels its middle is over the Pokémon's feet

shine.description: When the digits play their shine frames left to right once the number lands: never, on critical hits and hits at the damage cap, or on every hit

shine_delay.description: Frames from one digit's shine to the next's

hp_numbers.description: A foe's gauge shows its HP (up to 5 digits) and its bars left in the run's battles

prices.description: The tiers' default prices in Dream Dust

buckets.description: The damage buckets: bonuses in one add, buckets multiply each other

balance.description: The balance meter's inputs (the editor's Buffs tab, the packer's check)

reference_hit.description: A strong hit on a tanky boss before buffs (STAB, super effective and the top roll included)

count.description: Picks of a blue or purple, a gold's rank

example.description: A typical build, for the meter's second number

categories.description: The icons' categories: one icon each (buff_icons/<id>.png), drawn in the card's tier's palette (buff_icons/tier_<tier>.png)

bucket.description: A damage bucket. Its factor is (vanilla + the sum, at most cap) / vanilla, or / 100 for a critical_only bucket, whose vanilla factor the reference hit leaves out; a reducing one's is (100 - the sum) / 100

id.description: Its id, which buffs' bucket names

vanilla.description: Vanilla's factor in hundredths that the sum adds to (STAB 150, critical 200); left out, 100

cap.description: The cap of the sum, in hundredths of the factor

event.description: The host event of its handler (include/battle/btl_event.h)

category.description: An icon category: one 16 by 16 icon of up to 15 colors and transparency, whose indices the tier palettes color

id.description: Its stable id, which golds' theme names

buff.description: A card: blue or purple (stacking) or gold

stacking.description: A blue or purple card: each pick adds its step, halved past the soft limit, up to its cap; it leaves the pool at its cap

id.description: The buff's stable ID; renaming it doesn't change it

category.description: Its icon's category (categories' ids): buff_icons/<category>.png in its tier's palette

weight.description: Its weight in the draw among the cards of its tier

rounds.description: The rounds it is offered in; left out, every round

price.description: Its price in Dream Dust in a shop; left out, settings.prices' for its tier

pools.description: Where it is offered: after_battle, the 1 of 3 after a battle; gift, a gift NPC; buff_room, a buff room's choice; shop, a shop's goods

step.description: What one pick adds, in the effect kind's unit

soft_limit.description: Picks at the full step; later picks add half; left out, every pick is full

cap.description: The most its picks add up to, in the effect kind's unit

bucket.description: The damage bucket it adds to (buckets' ids); left out, none (not damage)

related.description: Gold themes it is related to: offered more while one is held (purples)

type_card.description: The card rolls a type when offered, weighted toward the team's types

gold.description: A gold card: a theme's boon in one of the gold slots, ranked up by picking it again

id.description: The buff's stable ID; renaming it doesn't change it

category.description: Its icon's category (categories' ids): buff_icons/<category>.png in its tier's palette

weight.description: Its weight in the draw among the cards of its tier

rounds.description: The rounds it is offered in; left out, every round

price.description: Its price in Dream Dust in a shop; left out, settings.prices' for its tier

pools.description: Where it is offered: after_battle, the 1 of 3 after a battle; gift, a gift NPC; buff_room, a buff room's choice; shop, a shop's goods

core.description: The theme's centrepiece, the gold it is built around (one a theme)

ranks.description: Its value at rank 1, 2 and 3, in the effect kind's unit (not added together)

bucket.description: The damage bucket it adds to (buckets' ids); left out, none (not damage)

condition.description: A situation: every field given must hold (any: one of its conditions)

defender_status.description: The target has one of these (any_major: any major status)

attacker_status.description: The attacker has one of these (for GUARD, the foe attacking)

move_type.description: The move is of this type

card_type.description: The move is of the type the card rolled (type cards)

attacker_hp_below.description: The attacker's HP is below this percent

power_at_most.description: The move's power is at most this

weather_boosted.description: The weather boosts the move (Fire in sun, Water in rain, Rock, Ground and Steel in sand, Ice in hail)

boss.description: The target is a boss or a raid target

effect.description: What it does: one of the effect kinds, with its parameters; the number comes from the step and cap (blue, purple) or the ranks (gold), in the kind's unit

effect_damage_ratio.description: Adds its value to its bucket while the condition holds. The bucket decides the host event and the side: POW and COND on the move's power, MATCH, CRIT and FINAL on the damage, GUARD on the damage the player's Pokémon take. Value: percent added to the bucket (GUARD: percent less damage taken)

condition.description: When it applies; left out, always. Every field given must hold

scale.description: Scales the value: missing_hp, the full value at 1 HP and none at full HP (linear in the HP missing); speed_gap, the full value at twice the target's Speed (linear from equal Speed); attack_stage, the value per positive stage of the attacking stat

exempt_from_bucket_cap.description: Not held to the bucket's cap (a resisted hit stays under a neutral one); the balance meter leaves it out of the strongest hit

hp_cost.description: Each attack also costs this percent of the user's max HP (vanilla Life Orb: 10)

halves_recoil_at_rank.description: From this rank on, the moves' recoil is halved too

immune_to.description: The team also can't be given these statuses, from rank 1

effect_stat_ratio.description: Raises a stat of the team's Pokémon in battle (ATK and DEF buckets for the attacking and defending stats; Speed outside the buckets). Value: percent of the stat

stat.description: The stat; attacking is the one the move uses (Attack or Sp. Atk), defending the one a hit on them uses (Defense or Sp. Def)

condition.description: When it applies; left out, always. Every field given must hold

scale.description: Scales the value: missing_hp, the full value at 1 HP and none at full HP (linear in the HP missing); speed_gap, the full value at twice the target's Speed (linear from equal Speed); attack_stage, the value per positive stage of the attacking stat

ignore_burn_drop.description: A burned Pokémon also keeps its full Attack (vanilla Guts)

effect_max_hp.description: Raises the run's copies' max HP, healing the gain. Value: percent of max HP

limit.description: Max HP never goes above this (the gauge shows 3 digits)

effect_stab_bonus.description: Adds to the same-type bonus (vanilla x1.5). Value: hundredths added to the multiplier (5 is +0.05)

condition.description: When it applies; left out, always. Every field given must hold

non_stab.description: The value is instead the STAB multiplier that moves of none of the user's types get, in hundredths (125 is x1.25); the balance meter leaves it out

effect_crit_stage.description: Raises the critical-hit stage (Gen 5: 1/16, 1/8, 1/4, 1/3, 1/2). Value: stages; 5 or more is a sure critical hit

condition.description: When it applies; left out, always. Every field given must hold

effect_crit_damage.description: Adds to critical hits' damage (vanilla x2), the CRIT bucket. Value: hundredths added to the multiplier (10 is x2.1)

effect_accuracy.description: Raises the moves' accuracy. Value: percent of the accuracy

condition.description: When it applies; left out, always. Every field given must hold

effect_residual_ratio.description: Multiplies residual damage the team's foes take (not a hit: no bucket). Value: percent added to the tick (50 is x1.5)

team_immune.description: The team takes none of it (weather)

effect_residual_fraction.description: Sets a residual tick's share of max HP on foes (one health bar on a boss). Value: the denominator: 8 is 1/8 of max HP a turn

source.description: sleeping_foes, a new tick on sleeping foes (vanilla Bad Dreams); leech_seed, Leech Seed's drain (vanilla 1/8)

spreads_at_rank.description: From this rank on, it spreads to the target's neighbours when the target faints

effect_heal_per_turn.description: Heals the team's Pokémon in battle at each turn's end (vanilla Leftovers). Value: the denominator: 16 is 1/16 of max HP

effect_heal_after_battle.description: Heals the team after each battle won (run code). Value: percent of max HP

effect_heal_on_damage.description: Heals the attacker by a share of the damage it deals (vanilla Shell Bell). Value: percent of the damage dealt

effect_heal_ratio.description: Makes a kind of healing heal more. Value: percent more

source.description: drain, draining moves and Leech Seed (vanilla Big Root); recovery_moves, Recover, Roost, Synthesis and the like

effect_recoil_ratio.description: Lowers recoil damage (vanilla Rock Head). Value: percent less

effect_added_effect_chance.description: Multiplies the added-effect chances of the team's moves (vanilla Serene Grace). Value: percent added to the chance's multiplier (20 is x1.2)

effect_flinch_chance.description: Raises the flinch chance of moves that flinch. Value: percentage points

effect_multi_hit.description: Multi-hit moves hit at least this many more times (vanilla Skill Link at 3). Value: hits

effect_pp_save_chance.description: A chance that a move uses no PP (PP carries between rooms). Value: percent

effect_status_chance_on_hit.description: The team's hits give a status by chance, after the hit. Value: percent

condition.description: When it applies; left out, always. Every field given must hold

replaces_freeze.description: The moves' own freeze chance gives this status instead

ignores_immunity_at_rank.description: From this rank on, the type that is immune to the status (Fire to burn) isn't

effect_status_duration.description: Lengthens or shortens a status' turns. Value: turns (own: fewer turns for the team's; foes: more for what the team inflicts)

effect_status_resist.description: Lowers the chance that the team is given a status. Value: percent less

effect_status_cure_chance.description: A chance at each turn's end to cure the Pokémon's own major status (vanilla Shed Skin). Value: percent

effect_status_roll.description: Replaces a status' fixed roll on the team's foes. Value: percent (vanilla 25 and 50)

roll.description: full_paralysis, the chance a paralyzed foe can't move (vanilla 25); confusion_self_hit, the chance a confused foe hits itself (vanilla 50)

effect_type_chart.description: Changes the type chart for the team's hits. Value: percent chance a hit is affected

mode.description: super_effective_chance, the hit ignores the chart and is super effective (x2)

overrides_immunity.description: Also on a type that is immune to the move (a Ghost move on a Normal type): the roll comes before the type immunity; abilities' immunities still hold

effect_weather_turns.description: Changes how long the weather the team sets lasts. Value: turns; 255 is until the battle ends

mode.description: add to vanilla's 5, or set the count

effect_screen_turns.description: Lengthens the team's Reflect and Light Screen (vanilla Light Clay). Value: turns

effect_endure_chance.description: A chance to survive a KO with 1 HP (vanilla Focus Band). Value: percent

effect_endure_once.description: Once a battle, each Pokémon survives a KO with 1 HP (vanilla Sturdy). Value: the percent of max HP it must have when hit (100 is from full HP, 0 always)

effect_stat_stage_on_entry.description: Raises stat stages when each Pokémon first enters a battle. Value: stages

stats_by_rank.description: The stats raised at each rank

effect_ability_like.description: The team's Pokémon act as if they also had an ability; the handler adds the gold's rank extras. Value: the rank's level (1 to 3) for the handler

effect_custom.description: A one-off with its own handler, named here; the description says what it does. Value: the handler's number for the rank (its description says which)
